**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EricTechPro/super-board/compare/v3.0.4...v3.1.2

detail.readme_excerpt:
super-board

Add tasks, walk away, get merged PRs with proof.

Stop babysitting coding agents: cards you drop in Ready come back as tested, reviewed PRs.

9 skills (5 you type, 4 the board runs) · 9 commands · 6 guard hooks

🌐 Live site: erictechpro.github.io/super-board

⭐ Star this repo if it helps · Join the builders using this → weekly live calls, setup help · ▶ Watch the walkthrough

Install · Quick start · How it works · Skills · Commands · Guards

The skill map. Click it for the live version: zoom, pan, open any node.

## Install Before you start: - [ ] Claude Code, and `gh` with board access: `gh auth refresh -s project,read:project,repo` - [ ] Dynamic workflows on in `/config` ([backends](docs/super-board/README.md#backends)) - [ ] `verify_commands` set in your config, so the merge gate can prove the build ([setup notes](docs/super-board/README.md#setup-notes)) In your project folder: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EricTechPro/super-board/main/get.sh | bash ``` Or as a Claude Code plugin: ``` /plugin marketplace add EricTechPro/super-board /plugin install super-board@super-board ``` > [!NOTE] > The plugin ships the skills only. Run `/super-board:super-board onboard` and its 🔍 Checks step adds the guard hooks, scripts and workflows. Needs Claude Code, `gh`, `jq`, bash 3.2+ and Python 3.9+; the installer checks. ### Security Two security skills come with every install, and they stay separate: | Skill | Runs | Covers | |---|---|---| | [`pr-security-review`](skills/pr-security-review/README.md) | **On every PR**, inside the QA lane. Each finding fails QA and goes back to Build. | The PR's diff against its base: high-confidence, exploitable bugs only. From Anthropic's [claude-code-security-review](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review). | | `security-audit` | **Only when you ask** (`/security-audit`).
